name: King James Version
_copy: Written 2026-09-04 to give the KJV the same data file every other translation already had. Values are what ACTUALLY SHIPPED in the 12 Bible-in-a-Year month videos, cross-checked against color-constitution.md.
_narration_note: David of openbible.com narrates BOTH the KJV and the MSB. Confirmed by Nigel 2026-09-04. Do not infer a narrator from audio duration: MSB's Genesis 1 is shorter (4:53 vs 5:39) because the MSB is a more concise translation (738 words vs 797), not because it is a different reader. Same reader, 152 vs 141 wpm.
_board_seconds_note: contents is 12.0 for Bible-in-a-Year, NOT the library's 7.5: a month board carries 31 rows instead of 5, and a signpost you cannot read is not a signpost. translation stays 5.5 for the KJV; MSB cut its to 2.75 ('come out swinging'). The intro builder reads each clip's own duration off disk, so these are documentation, not inputs.
_palette_note: ink #26324f is the shipped navy, which THE INK RULE reproduces from gold (hue 42 -> complement 222). color-constitution.md gives paper as #fcfcfc; the shipped BIAY boards use #ffffff. The difference is 3/255 and invisible, but #ffffff is recorded here because it is what is in the uploaded videos. Reconcile deliberately, not by accident.
